1. Founders prepared for pitch event in the following manner:
• Participants provided best practice information on overall pitch and pitch deck.
• Best practice information is posted and accessible on the program resource board/platform (ie. Notion) or delivered via their program communication channel via PDF (ie. Slack).

Mastering Your Pitch masterclass, pitch practice sessions, and mentor coaching availability). *Preparation in this milestone will overlap the core program delivery.
Evidence:
Various resources were provided to help founders craft and prepare a successful pitch. Masterclass 4”Mastering Your Pitch” was taught by Techstars Managing Director, Dave Cass. The session was presented and followed by opportunities for the founders to ask questions.
Two sessions were held (one mandatory, one optional) by our video editor, Neil Carroll to provide founders with examples of good pitches and insight on how to record and present a great pitch. These resources were then reshared in Slack following the session.
Techstars Associate, Alex Cottingham, was a dedicated team member whose main purpose was to meet with founders to work through their pitch, help them with their storytelling, and help the founders learn the structure of a successful pitch. Founders were able to book with her via the mentor deck throughout the program up until their pitches were due.
Here is the Pitch Preparation document from Design & Communications Associate, Alex Cottingham which she provided to founders in conjunction with holding office hours with them included as an additional example of preparation materials provided in print/document format: https://docs.google.com/document/d/19GHfYDgC_XPPnDXbjtOCLv9nmtf0duPb--wilws9hcM/edit?usp=sharing

ms.report:
A. Output: 
1. Inform participants about program close and post program support.
Acceptance criteria: 
1.Techstars will communicate with founders regarding final housekeeping and post program support tools and resources in the following way:
• Participants receive information on continuation, archiving, or closure of certain program resources like the Techstars Toolkit, the communication channel (ie. Slack) or the mentor deck.
• Participants receive an invitation to our Founder Catalyst alumni forum or platform.
• Participants provided with a link to a post-program founder survey and encouraged to complete it to provide feedback on their experience in the program. 
* Please note: Portions of the response data collected will be used in the final close out report and video mentioned below. Other data may be excluded if the data is of a private nature, is redundant, or is not within the scope of data requested by the Cardano Project Catalyst report and video requirements. Techstars will strive to report on the relevant data while also protecting the privacy, preferences, and or anonymity of our founders in their responses. 
* Please note that we strongly encourage at least one representative from every company to fill out the post-program founder survey and aim for a 75% company response rate. That said, just as we respect the founder’s right to share their genuine thoughts and feedback on the program via the survey, we also respect their right to refrain from responding if that is their preference. Thus, the response percentage goal is arbitrary, even though we aim for a high percentage of participation. 
• Participants provided a link to fill out a post-program alumni form to verify their contact information is up to date (for Techstars internal use only).
Evidence: Deck presented to and shared with program graduates outlining post-program support and resources in their final program meeting: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1O_jzxarxrB5F4O-quBbhqFrlzIz66wxc/view?usp=
